title: Cue scrubber
description: A segmented timeline makes meaningful chapter boundaries visible and directly seekable.
useCase: Jump to a meaningful moment without scanning an entire recording.
interaction: Preview a cue on hover, jump to a chapter or scrub the clock.
reducedMotion: Clock updates remain functional; no eased marker travel or scene transition.
limitations: A silent 32-second chapter timeline; no video or external media.
look: Off-white page with a giant dark chapter numeral and title, a segmented grey timeline with one dark segment and red handle, and small chapter labels.
motion: Play runs a frame-driven 32 s clock that carries the red handle across four chapter segments, darkening the current one; hovering the track floats a chapter-and-time label.
adapt: Playback is the `tick` loop in a `requestAnimationFrame` effect writing `clock` and `time`; `seek` jumps, and segment widths derive from `CUES` and `DURATION`. Replace `CUES` with your chapters and drive `time` from a real media element's current time.
